intent: Analyze the impact of changed human sources, shared contracts, architecture or policy on existing Work Units and derived project state.
steps: Identify the trigger: authoritative human source change, shared contract change, structural migration proposal, or constitution version change
Enumerate Work Units potentially affected by the change
Classify each affected Work Unit as unaffected, needs context refresh, needs reverification, invalidated needs recompile, or blocked pending decision
Identify derived project state elements that contradict the changed authoritative source
Report required follow-up actions: context rebuild, re-verification, recompilation or human decision
Never silently preserve a derived plan that contradicts a changed authoritative source
invariants: Treat changed authoritative sources as overriding stale derived state
Do not invent product decisions to resolve conflicts
Surface blocked pending decision cases explicitly
